description: Demonstrates if/else routing between agents based on classifier output.

agents.name: Intent Classifier
agents.prompt: Classify the user's intent. Reply with exactly one word: 'technical', 'billing', or 'general'.

agents.name: Technical Support Agent
agents.prompt: You are a technical support specialist. Resolve the user's technical issue: {{user_input}}

agents.name: Billing Agent
agents.prompt: You are a billing specialist. Address the user's billing concern: {{user_input}}

agents.name: General Support Agent
agents.prompt: You are a general support agent. Help the user with: {{user_input}}
